properties.name: certin:9.3(15):intended_usage
properties.value: BOM Automation assesses Bill of Materials submissions against the CERT-In Technical Guidelines v2.0 and produces a clause-referenced conformance assessment. Language models are used for three things only: classifying intake, drafting narrative prose about verdicts the deterministic engine already computed, and assembling evidence for a VEX justification that an analyst then determines. Every verdict, score and clause reference is produced by deterministic code and is enforced as such by a blocking gate.

properties.name: certin:9.3(16):out_of_scope_usage
properties.value: This product does not issue legal or regulatory opinions. A conformance assessment states whether a submission meets the minimum elements of a published technical guideline; it does not establish legal compliance, contractual adequacy or regulatory standing, and it must not be relied upon as advice on any of those. It does not determine VEX status: the four statuses of recommendation 7.1.6 are an analyst's professional judgement and the API refuses an agent-set status. It does not certify a supplier, and a passing score is not an assurance that software is secure — it states that the declaration is complete, not that what was declared is safe. It is not a vulnerability scanner and does not test running systems.

modelParameters.task: intake classification and cheap structural checks

inputs.format: BOM metadata and structural summaries; never full BOM payloads

technicalLimitations: produces no verdict, figure or clause reference; those come from services/score and services/catalogue and are enforced in code

modelParameters.task: assessment narrative, VEX justification drafting, critic loop

inputs.format: computed verdicts, scores and clause references as inputs to restate

outputs.format: prose only; never a status, verdict, figure or clause

technicalLimitations: drafts VEX justifications but never sets a VEX status — the four statuses of rec. 7.1.6 are an analyst's determination
